body_fields.base_member_revisions: bounded reviewed page tokens plus complete server-bound fingerprint; client cannot substitute an unbounded authoritative member list

PendingRfcTerminalCascadeQueryV1.rule: cursor semantic body is pinned by queries/rfc-lifecycle.json GetPendingRfcTerminalCascade and binds the resolved pending proposal identity/revision/scope fingerprint

RfcTerminalCascadePreviewQueryV1.rule: cursor is bound to exact proposal revision plus preview_fingerprint; changed scope or cross-domain impact authority invalidates continuation

body_fields.uow: existing LLD-01 UnitOfWork owned by LLD-04 AcceptReconciliationProposal
body_fields.proposal: accepted LLD-04 RFC reconciliation proposal carrying exact proposal/revision/fingerprint/base-token bindings and accepted source-evidence delta
body_fields.command_context: in-process LLD-04 parent command context carrying outer command_id/hash and already-inserted parent command_receipt reference

fields.scope_fingerprint: sha256 hex computed over the complete current scope and revisions

RfcArchivePreviewV1.rule: Transport paging never weakens scope authority: the command recomputes the complete server-side fingerprint under the writer lock.

fields.members: bounded ordered array<operation member/latest event/current restore eligibility>

RfcArchiveOperationV1.rule: Operation identity/membership are immutable; restore eligibility is derived from latest per-member archive events. Mutation responses may return the first bounded page and clients continue through the read route.

RfcTerminalCascadeStateV1.rule: scope_fingerprint and terminal evidence are exact persisted proposal capture authority and are never rebuilt from paged response members for replay/read.

RfcTerminalCascadeDetailV1.rule: members are persisted immutable evidence ordered RFC before WFM then stored ordinal/member identity; continuation is bound to the exact pending proposal by the query filter fingerprint.

fields.rfc_members: complete ordered immutable array<RfcTerminalCascadeRfcMemberV1 without transport ordinal duplication ambiguity>
fields.wfm_members: complete ordered immutable array<RfcTerminalCascadeWfmMemberV1 without transport ordinal duplication ambiguity>

RfcTerminalCascadeProposalSnapshotV1.rule: internal participant snapshot is complete persisted proposal authority, never reconstructed from a paged transport response

rules: TICKETS/RFC_TERMINAL_SCOPE_MEMBER uses entity_type RFC; current_state is root|subordinate|standalone; resulting_state is included; counts and attention are null
TASKS_OBJECTIVES/WFM_TERMINATION uses entity_type WFM_TASK; current_state is not_started|in_progress; resulting_state is terminated; counts and attention are null

TASKS_OBJECTIVES/OBJECTIVE_EXECUTABLE_COUNT uses entity_type OBJECTIVE; current/resulting counts are required; attention_code is LOST_LAST_EXECUTABLE only when resulting_count=0 from a positive current_count and the Objective consequence requires attention
COMMUNICATIONS/RFC_TERMINAL_SUMMARY_FREEZE uses entity_type RFC; resulting_state is frozen and count fields are null
COMMUNICATIONS/RFC_DIRECT_LINK_CLOSE uses entity_type COMMUNICATION_LINK; current_state is active; resulting_state is closed; count fields are null

COMMUNICATIONS/ORPHAN_GRACE_EVALUATION uses entity_type COMMUNICATION; current_state is RETAINED; resulting_state is RETAINED|ORPHAN_PENDING_PURGE; current/resulting counts are protected-dependency counts and attention is null
READY requires non-null exact_count/provider_fingerprint, all items match domain and are strictly ordered impact_kind then entity_id UTF-8 ascending
INDETERMINATE requires exact_count/provider_fingerprint null, items empty, continuation_key null and non-null warning_code
provider_fingerprint binds the complete current ordered provider impact set and authoritative input revisions, not merely the returned page

fields.current_scope_fingerprint: freshly recomputed SOMA_RFC_TERMINAL_CASCADE_SCOPE_V1 lowercase sha256 hex|null when current terminal epoch/binding cannot form executable scope

RfcTerminalCascadePreviewV1.rule: Complete scope/evidence and provider-impact fingerprints are computed server-side before paging. Any stale reason or INDETERMINATE provider makes execution_ready=false. If any provider is INDETERMINATE impacts is empty and continuation is null, avoiding a partial cross-domain impact page.

fields.blockers: bounded typed array from the closed hard-delete guard registry
